title: Resume a Chat Stream After Reconnect
signature: def stream_chat(connect, backfill, on_event, clock, rand, max_failures=5, base=0.5, cap=8.0)
hints: Keep one number, last_id: the id of the last event you delivered. Reconnect with connect(last_id), never with 0.
The server's replay can overlap what you already have. Skip any event with id <= last_id.
If an event jumps past last_id + 1, call backfill(last_id, ev['id']) and deliver those first, so the transcript has no holes.
Count consecutive failures, reset the count whenever a new event is delivered, and sleep rand() * min(cap, base * 2**(failures - 1)) before reconnecting.
